product_one_liner.value: Open Dental provides customizable dental practice-management software for dental offices of any size.
product_one_liner.notes: Open Dental’s homepage describes customizable dental practice-management software for practices of any size.

pricing_page.notes: The company has a public Fees for Support and Services page, and it describes its upfront support-fee cost; a public fees/pricing page exists even if it is not a conventional SaaS plan table.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: A TrustRadius review identifies Aspen Hill Smiles Family Dentistry as a practice using Open Dental; the New Garden Dental case study says the practice used Open Dental. | named_customers.0: The review identifies Aspen Hill Smiles Family Dentistry as a practice using Open Dental. | named_customers.1: The case study says New Garden Dental used Open Dental.

employee_band.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile lists 221 employees, which falls in the 201–500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company contact page gives its address in Salem, Oregon. | hq_country: The company profile identifies the locality as Salem, Oregon, and the country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: The company employment page states it was founded in 2003.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows product/update and marketing-oriented posts; the available engineering interview is a single post from 2023, not two posts about how the product is built. This meets the rule for false, though the conclusion is based on the visible index and retrieved post history.

public_docs.notes: The site links to a public Quick Manual, API Developer Portal, and programming resources, meeting the requirement for public documentation/developer resources.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The active careers page lists roles including Dental Assistant/Software Support and UI/UX software-engineering positions, with no AI, ML, data-science, or related-title role shown.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Open Dental’s HIPAA page says its HIPAA procedures and policies are current and that it follows HIPAA security and privacy guidelines. It names HIPAA, although it does not say that Open Dental holds a formal certification, so this interpretation has some uncertainty. | compliance_certs.0: The cited company page names HIPAA and describes Open Dental’s HIPAA procedures and guidelines.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The Tracxn profile states that Open Dental has not raised any funding, so the most recent funding stage is none; no date or amount applies.

raised_18mo.notes: Tracxn states that Open Dental has not raised any funding, so it did not raise a round in the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The active positions shown on the careers page include support roles and no SDR, BDR, sales representative, business development representative, or account executive position.

launched_6mo.notes: The company says Version 26.1 was released as stable on August 6, 2026, within the six-month window; the version page lists new features.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available org chart lists Nathan Sparks as founder and CEO and shows no other C-level or VP-level leader. A company history says Nathan was hired as CEO by 2022, and a July 2026 announcement still identifies him as CEO; the checked leadership evidence shows no C/VP change in the window, but the org-chart source is unverified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The technology-profile page lists Adobe Marketing Cloud under Open Dental Software’s marketing technology; this is a third-party stack attribution rather than a first-party statement. | crm_stack_signal.0: The technology-profile page names Adobe Marketing Cloud under marketing technology for Open Dental Software.
